source_refs.note: 2- Chromatin Fibre: a main subheading of 19.1.2 Chemical Composition and Organization of Chromosome, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 118-118.

blocks.text: Cell division ke shuru ke marahil mein nucleosome string apne mehwar (axis) ke gird dobara lipat-ti hai. Ghane (condensed) nucleosomes mil kar aik mota fibre banate hain jise chromatin fibre (30 nm) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Chromatin ke do hisse hote hain. Chromatin ke ghair fa'al (inactive) hisse gehri pattiyan (dark bands) banate hain aur heterochromatin kehlate hain. Chromosomes ke fa'al (active) hisse euchromatin kehlate hain.
